bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = f6b8c36315a8bf8dfc5ff91fde3bd8be40ed5c89
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' debug-ai-debug-ai-1)" = false
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import io,json,re,subprocess,tarfile
container="debug-ai-debug-ai-1"
bid="realdebug_6cf69ffdd7f641cba693aa2e9783c9aa"
def records(path):
    raw=subprocess.check_output(["docker","cp",container+":"+path,"-"])
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(raw)) as a:
        return [json.load(a.extractfile(m)) for m in a.getmembers() if m.isfile() and m.name.endswith(".json")]
states=[r["payload"] for r in records("/app/runtime/durable/durable/run-state-v2") if r.get("payload",{}).get("schema")=="run-state/v2"]
active=[s for s in states if s.get("job_status") in ("QUEUED","RUNNING","RETRY_WAIT","PAUSED")]
cp=sorted([r for r in records("/app/runtime/"+bid) if r.get("type")=="real_debug_benchmark"],key=lambda r:r.get("created_at",0))[-1]["payload"]
assert cp["benchmark_id"]==bid and cp["schema"]=="debugai.real-debug-benchmark/v1"
for s in active:
    case=cp["current"]["case_id"]
    assert s["run_id"]==cp["current"]["run_id"] and s["project_id"]=="debugai-real-debug-"+case
    assert s["project_dir"].endswith("/debug-ai/.verification/real-debug/"+bid+"/"+case)
assert len(active)<=1
print("ONLY_INTERRUPTED_BENCHMARK_CHILD; OWNER_CHECKPOINT_MATCH; NO_UNRELATED_ACTIVE_RUN")
PY
